provenance.what: First live-model run of the golden set, on the corpus with the superseded archive copy removed.
provenance.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, Q4_K_M, via llama.cpp on 4 CPU cores
provenance.corpus: evals/corpus/aveline minus archive/ - 10 documents across Markdown, Word, Excel and PDF
provenance.golden_set: evals/golden-aveline - 26 cases, 17 answerable, 9 must-refuse, 37 wrong-answer guards, none unguarded
provenance.set_can_fail: Every answerable case rejects its own forbidden answer; asserted by tests/test_evaluation.py.
provenance.not_evidence_of: accuracy on real documents. The corpus and the questions were written together, which is the circularity that makes a benchmark flattering. It shows the pipeline behaves.
provenance.reproduce: docs/TEST-RUN.md, appendix: running the local tier with no Ollama
